third_party_evaluations.summary: PECB credential for implementing ISMS per ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded ISMS implementation scope and accreditation support professional governance delivery at three years; no described senior practice assessment supports expert placement.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded accredited scheme and ISMS implementation focus support professional governance delivery at the three-year profile. No practical project assessment is specified, limiting proof that the holder has independently implemented a working ISMS.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded ISO 27001 implementation scope and three-year profile fit professional responsibility for an ISMS. Accreditation supports assessment credibility, while practical technical implementation is not separately documented.
